subject: Hosted API evaluation request — CloudRelay
messages:
From: Eva Schultz <eva@cloudrelay.com>
To: Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwood.ai>
Date: Tue, 15 Sep 2026 14:22:00 -0700
Subject: Hosted API evaluation request — CloudRelay

Hi Kimberly,

We signed up for the hosted API sandbox yesterday and I wanted to see if someone from Redwood could do a short walkthrough with our product engineering team. We want to validate latency and a couple of embedding workflows before we commit to a dedicated evaluation.

Ideal window for us is Thursday morning PT or Friday afternoon PT. We have a distributed team (SF + Denver + Stockholm) so timezone flexibility would help.

A few bullets about our goals:
- Validate generation latency at 512 tokens
- Test embeddings for search (encyclopedic + product docs)
- Quick look at cost controls (batching / quantization suggestions)

Can you propose 2–3 times and whether you’d bring an engineer or an AE?

Thanks,
Eva Schultz
Director of Product
CloudRelay

From: Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwood.ai>
To: Eva Schultz <eva@cloudrelay.com>
Cc: Rishi Malhotra <rishi_malhotra@redwood.ai>
Date: Tue, 15 Sep 2026 15:03:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Hosted API evaluation request — CloudRelay

Hi Eva — great to meet you and thanks for signing up. Happy to run a focused 30-minute eval walkthrough. I recommend we cover latency + embeddings and leave time for Qs.

Proposed times (all PT):
- Thu 2026-09-17 09:30–10:00
- Thu 2026-09-17 11:30–12:00
- Fri 2026-09-18 15:00–15:30

I’ll bring an engineer (Rishi) to field any deep latency/kv-cache questions — looping him in. I’ve attached a short quickstart PDF and a mutual action plan template so we can record acceptance criteria and next steps. If those times don’t work, paste a few alternatives and I’ll adapt.

Attachments: hostedapi-quickstart.pdf (pdf), mutual-action-plan-CR-77.xlsx (xlsx)

Best,
Kimberly Park
SDR Lead, North America
Redwood Inference

From: Eva Schultz <eva@cloudrelay.com>
To: Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwood.ai>
Date: Wed, 16 Sep 2026 08:10:00 +01:00
Subject: Re: Hosted API evaluation request — CloudRelay

Thanks Kimberly — quick note on times: Friday afternoon PT is problematic for our Stockholm folks (that’s late evening). Can we do Thu 11:30 PT? That maps to 20:30 CEST but our Stockholm engineer can join for the first 15 minutes and then we’ll hand off to Denver/SF.

If that slot is still available we’ll take it. Also, can Rishi focus on the latency breakdown and any suggestions we should try in the sandbox before the call (e.g., quantization flags or batch sizes)?

Cheers,
Eva

From: Rishi Malhotra <rishi_malhotra@redwood.ai>
To: Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwood.ai>
Date: Wed, 16 Sep 2026 08:37:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Hosted API evaluation request — CloudRelay

Kim — I can take Thu 2026-09-17 11:30 PT. I’ll prepare a short latency slide (under 5 min) and a sandbox checklist: token budgets, batch-config, and quantization options that are low-friction to test. If you want, I can also paste a couple curl examples to pre-run so CloudRelay has baseline numbers in the meeting.

If you want me to lead the first 10 minutes, I’ll be ready.
Rishi
Senior SRE, Redwood Inference

From: Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwood.ai>
To: Eva Schultz <eva@cloudrelay.com>
Cc: Rishi Malhotra <rishi_malhotra@redwood.ai>, Diego Fernandez <diego_fernandez@redwood.ai>
Date: Thu, 17 Sep 2026 09:12:00 -07:00
Subject: Confirmed: Hosted API eval — Thu 2026-09-17 11:30 PT

Eva — confirmed for Thu 11:30 PT. Calendar invite sent (15 + 15 buffer). Rishi will open with a 5-minute latency checklist and a couple of curl snippets to run. I’ll cover embeddings use cases and cost controls, and Diego will be on the thread for any billing/quoting questions.

Pre-call asks (one-liners you can paste in reply):
- Which dataset will you use for embeddings? (docs / product_text / combined)
- Expected concurrency during tests (single dev vs automated job)

Looking forward to it — invite includes a link to the shared MAP in Drive: https://drive.redwood.ai/drive/folders/1A2B3C-MAP-CR-77 and a 15-min follow-up placeholder for next steps.

Best,
Kimberly
